request: I ave some feedback from you, currently the animations pane makes it hard to understand how to merge tails from models, so I just accidentally added werewolfs animations into the clps panel where shiv's animations are after loading werewolfs model, so the map channels and blend all buttons are ambiguous and I don't know how to merge them. Also some heroes like drifter for example import at a lagrer size and rotated weirdly, and the hero scanner should be expanded, since currently stuff like werewolf transform aren't included, there's two nanos, familiar wip is the right familiar and I don't know if it handles it so it might be operating off of familiar without the wip, minions and troopers and npcs aren't included in things, currently the tail previews are too large and stretch the side by side panes instead of having multiple smaller panes
findings: clipops.roots added every candidate path, including a stale extraction, so loading a Werewolf body could still discover Shiv clips
DMF_OT_import_hero never cleared or rescanned the clip list
the AnimGraph filter was inverted: row.ag != wanted
tail blend used the active clip row implicitly and blend_tail_all wrote every imported row regardless of hero
live.list_heroes read only top-level heroes.vdata entries, missing transform bodies, alternate bodies, minions, troopers and NPCs
choose_body did not recognize drifter_model or werewolf_hull and allowed animation DMX in the fallback
companion imports left a sampled animation pose on all 128 Drifter bones; the mesh data was upright but the evaluated body was 90x75x60 and looked rotated
Tails used two columns and template_icon(scale=5.0)
fixes: clip roots follow the current body/model and only add an extraction that contains the body
hero import clears rows, rescans current clips, tags source_hero, and clears the old tail pairing
AnimGraph filter now uses row.ag == wanted
Tails page has an explicit Source clip enum, selected-source card, Pair hero tail bones, Write selected clip to tail, and Write every <hero> clip to tail; the all-write is scoped to source_hero
live.list_heroes augments the roster from models/heroes_wip, models/heroes_staging and models/npc with character variants and excludes props
looks_like_body accepts model/hull and _body_score rejects clips/animation/anims folders
import_hero resets the bind pose; import_companions snapshots/restores pose, action and NLA state, removes failed-candidate actions, and resets the bind pose after the loop
Tails grid is three columns at icon scale 2.2
evidence: tail UI probe 8/8 with 40 live/local options
Drifter operator probe: body repaired, dimensions 28.84x83.71x108.86, pose bones 0, 218 drifter clips, no Shiv rows, tail rows 0
